_about: Hand-worked reference values for Phase 6 acceptance test 8 (Cowork, 2026-10-25). Wilson score interval, z = 1.959963984540054 (95%), no continuity correction. Exact McNemar = two-sided binomial test on the discordant cases, p = min(1, 2 * sum_{i<=min(b,c)} C(n,i) / 2^n), n = b + c. Compare with relative tolerance 1e-9.
